reviewed_by: Codex review of nebula-v3.0.15 assistant release gate traces
reason: The failed production LAN queue journey exposed a URL session selection race: the composer accepted input before Core selected that conversation and restored its draft. A flaky linked-browser journey showed a navigation request replayed on reload before its session-storage marker was written. Select the exact real-Core queue and link cases plus their rendered desktop, compact, mobile Chromium, and mobile WebKit link and queue journeys. URL, Core session and tab state, and session storage are the relevant authorities; the shared assistant composer and browser companion impact was reviewed against these journeys.
exclusions: No backend or native source changed. No standalone unit test covers these rendered lifecycle races, so Python, frontend unit, and native selections are empty. Unrelated assistant and browser journeys are excluded; a full suite was not requested.
